# Paceline Running

> A responsive running-storefront frontend demo based on the supplied DCS Web Cluster design.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured collections, product categories, catalogue filters, and local shopping demo.
- [About](/about): Paceline story, principles, timeline, Glasgow visit information, and founders.

## Project notes

- Product, catalogue, account, shopping bag, and newsletter actions are front-end demonstrations and do not connect to a backend.
- The project setup and local development instructions are in [README.md](/README.md).
